name: Move Action
text: Move up to as many m/yds as your MOVE STAT x 2 each Turn (or squares equal to your MOVE STAT).

name: Attack
text: Make a Melee or Ranged Attack.

name: Choke
text: Choke an opponent you have Grabbed.

name: Equip/Drop Shield
text: Equipping and dropping a Shield takes an Action. See Using Shields later in this section on pg. 183.
transcription_note: In-book cross-references are printed page numbers; the file is printed + 1.

name: Get into a Vehicle
text: Get into a Vehicle. See Vehicle Combat later in this section on pg. 189.
transcription_note: In-book cross-references are printed page numbers; the file is printed + 1.

name: Get Up
text: Get up after being Prone. While Prone, until you use this Action, you cannot use a Move Action.

name: Grab
text: Grab and hold an opponent or take away an object they are holding.

name: Hold Action
text: Hold an Action until later in the Initiative Queue. You must choose a specified event to trigger the Action or a specific number in the Initiative Queue when the action occurs as well as what the Action is, and what its intended target is.

name: Human Shield
text: Equip an opponent you have Grabbed as a Human Shield.

name: Reload
text: Fully reload and replace a weapon's magazine with a single ammunition type.

name: Run
text: Take an additional Move Action, but only if you have already taken a Move Action this Turn.

name: Start a Vehicle
text: Start a Vehicle to gain its MOVE and jump to the top of the Initiative Queue.

name: Stabilize
text: Stabilize a target to begin the natural healing process or pull them out of the Mortally Wounded Wound State to save their life. See on pg. 222.
transcription_note: In-book cross-references are printed page numbers; the file is printed + 1.

name: Throw
text: Throw a grabbed opponent to the ground or throw an object.

name: Use NET Actions
text: Perform multiple NET Actions inside the NET. See Netrunning Section for how to use NET Actions on pg. 197.
transcription_note: In-book cross-references are printed page numbers; the file is printed + 1.

name: Use an Object
text: Manipulate an object in a way that doesn't require a Skill. Drawing an easily accessible weapon into a free hand or dropping a held weapon (not a shield) onto the floor does not require this Action but stowing a held weapon on your person does.

name: Use a Skill
text: Use one of your Skills to accomplish a quick task. A longer task will require multiple Actions over the course of multiple Turns, rolling only when the full time has been paid for in 3-second increments.

name: Vehicle Maneuver
text: Use your Action while driving to focus entirely on making a dangerous Maneuver.
